english.title: Proceeds of Crime - other nominated person fail to disclose in regulated sector - money launder
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in the course of business as a nominated officer, knowing or suspecting that another person was engaged in money laundering as a consequence of a disclosure made to you under

(A)_[section 337]_
(B)_[section 338]_

of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, failed to make the required disclosure to an authorised person as soon as was practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 332 and 334(2) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 332(6) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 for circumstances in which a person does not commit this offence.
(ii) See section 332(5) for an explanation of the term "required disclosure".
(iii) MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 334(2) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, section 282(2) and (3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
